generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL TERMS AND CONDITIONS AS PER TENDER DOCUMENT

technicalCriterionList.description: The contractor must possess an experience certificate issued by an official at the district level, with a rank of at least Deputy Conservator of Forests attesting to the successful execution and completion of similar works for the Forest Department or other government departments.
Contractor should be registered in public works department as class-1 and such registration should be valid up to 2026-27
A copy of TAN/PAN no issued under income tax 1967 issued by income department
A copy of GST registeration Certificate under GST act
A copy of List of Skilled, semi skilled, un skilled labours long with copy of Registration in Labour Department,
A copy of Solvency Certificate having minimum 30% of PerTender value amount by Centralised or Scheduled Bank
